title: Microsoft.Entra/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests
description: A PIM eligible directory role assignment, shaped like ARM's Microsoft.Authorization/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests. The resource name is a deterministic GUID chosen with guid() (a label, not the identity); the eligibility is matched by (principalId, roleDefinitionId, directoryScopeId or appScopeId) and read live on every run. Created with action adminAssign, changed in place with adminUpdate, removed with adminRemove; justification and ticketInfo are request metadata, sent on every request and never compared. condition, conditionVersion and the target*ScheduleId properties of ARM are refused.

principalId.description: Required: object id of the user, role-assignable group or service principal made eligible.

roleDefinitionId.description: The role template id (use roleTemplate('Display Name')), or use role. Not both.

role.description: EARM sugar: role template id, built-in role name, custom role display name or id; resolved to roleDefinitionId. Not with roleDefinitionId.

directoryScopeId.description: Scope: '/' (tenant, default), '/administrativeUnits/{id}' or '/{objectId}'. At most one of directoryScopeId, administrativeUnit and appScopeId.

administrativeUnit.description: EARM sugar for an administrative-unit scope: the unit's object id or its displayName; resolved to directoryScopeId.

appScopeId.description: An app-specific scope instead of a directory scope ('/' for tenant-wide app scopes).

requestType.description: Optional and only AdminAssign (any casing), so ARM snippets paste unchanged; EARM chooses adminAssign / adminUpdate / adminRemove itself.

scheduleInfo.description: The eligibility period. Absent: permanent (expiration type NoExpiration).

startDateTime.description: ISO 8601 start; absent or in the past means now (a past start is never drift).

type.description: NoExpiration, AfterDateTime (needs endDateTime) or AfterDuration (needs duration); any casing, sent in Graph's camelCase.

endDateTime.description: AfterDateTime: the ISO 8601 end, after startDateTime. Compared with a 1 s tolerance.

duration.description: AfterDuration: an ISO 8601 duration such as P365D or PT8H. Applied when the eligibility is created and never compared afterwards.

justification.description: Request metadata, sent on every request and never compared (default "Deployed by earm"); PIM policy may require it.

ticketInfo.description: Request metadata, sent on every request and never compared.

permissions.notes: Learn (rbacapplication-post-roleeligibilityschedulerequests, rbacapplication-list-roleeligibilityschedules): RoleEligibilitySchedule.ReadWrite.Directory is the least privileged permission for the requests (delegated and application); reads need RoleEligibilitySchedule.Read.Directory. Delegated callers need Privileged Role Administrator (Global Reader suffices for reads). Directory.Read.All covers the principal-kind check and the role / administrative unit name lookups. The tenant needs Microsoft Entra ID P2 or ID Governance.
